ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the federal freeze on the state's Medicaid program.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the federal freeze affect Minnesota's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight of Medicaid programs.
